content: 'Aitsika mawarika hetsiemieme
Yawé Muitsexi mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe
'ixaheritsixi mɨpaɨ mɨtiwatahɨawekɨ: «Kepauka xemeutahaxɨani kwietsie hakewa nemɨxehexatɨa mana xemutitenikɨ,

xɨka xewitɨ Yawé reumawiriemɨkɨni, xeime wakaxi, xeime muxa, meta mawari taipa warɨkariekame, mawari taiyariyari meta mɨyɨhɨritɨani mawariyari, yatɨni kemɨtiyuwaɨriya mawariyari, yatɨni 'ixɨarari patsiekamekɨ memɨyukuxexeɨriwa. Mɨkɨ mawarika witsimu'ɨa Yawé minake,
kemɨ'ane yumawari mɨyetuani kanenayatsamɨkɨ hatsite mawariyari, huta kiruyari tɨriku mɨtɨxiyari 'aixɨa mɨ'ane hatseiti xeirituruyarikɨ pɨnariekame.
Yawé xɨka muxa nunutsi 'utimawirieni mawari taiyariyari mayanikɨ, yaxeikɨata heutinɨkame xeirituruyari kaxie winuyari mɨtayeuriwa.
»Muxa 'uki xɨka hɨkɨtɨni, hamatɨana hatsite mawariyari kaniyetuamɨkɨ nauka kiruyari tɨriku mɨtɨxiyari 'aixɨa mɨ'ane, hatseiti xeirituruyari heimana 'imeriyukɨ pɨnariekame.
Mɨta'ɨyarienikɨ winu xeirituruyari heimana 'imeriyu. Mɨpaɨ 'anetɨ 'aixɨa 'u'ɨatɨ kanayeimɨkɨ Yawé hetsiemieme.
»Xɨka tsikeru xeime peyetuamɨkɨ mawari taiyariyari mayanikɨ, yatɨni kemɨtiyɨhɨritɨa meye'atɨanikɨ, yatɨni 'aixɨa memɨteyuxeiyanikɨ mawariyari Yawé hetsiemieme,
tsikeru hamatɨa pekanitimawamɨkɨ hatsite mawariyari, 'ataxewime kiruyari tɨriku mɨtɨxiyari 'aixɨa mɨ'ane huta rituruyari hatseitikɨ pɨnariekame.
Yaxeikɨata kaxie winuyari mɨtiyeuriwa huta rituruyari heutinɨkame. Taipa warɨkariekame mawariyari mayanikɨ, mɨkɨ mawarika witsimu'ɨa Yawé minake.
Yuxexuitɨ wamawarikayari tsikeru, muxa 'uki, muxa temaikɨ, meta tsipu, yapɨtikuwewiwani kemɨre'inɨari.
Mɨpaɨ pekatiniyurienemɨkɨ yuxexuime wahetsiemieme, tsepa kememɨyupaɨme tewaxi pemɨwayetua.
»Kemɨ'ane 'Ixaheri tewiyari mɨtitimawa taipa miemeyaritsie, Yawé 'aixɨa mɨti'ɨkwekɨ, 'ikɨ 'aitsika kehaye'atɨani.
Yatɨni ku'uwamete xehamatɨa muka yaxeikɨa katiniyurimɨkɨ taipa mawariyari meta 'aixɨa mu'ɨa Yawé hetsiemieme wewimɨkɨni 'ikɨ 'aitsika kehaye'atɨani,

xekiekaritsie xewitɨ 'aitsika xeikɨa kaniuyeikamɨkɨ 'ahetsiemieme meta 'ateewa kiekame hetsie 'akiekaritsie muka. 'Ikɨ 'aitsika 'anuiwarima wahetsiemieme kanihɨkɨtɨni. 'Ekɨ meta 'ateewa kiekame yaxeikɨa xekani'aneneni Yawé hɨxie.
'Ayumieme mɨkɨ 'aitsika xeyunaime xehetsie katini'aitani 'ahetsie meta kuyeikame hetsie 'ahamatɨa muka».
'Ikwaxi matɨari mieme mawariyari
Yawé Muitsexi mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe
'ixaheritsixi mɨpaɨ mɨtiwatahɨawekɨ: «Kepauka kwietsie xemeutahaxɨani hakewa nemɨxehewitɨ,
mana mɨretixuxuawere xɨka xetehetikwani, Yawé hetsie timieme xekateneyetuakuni.
Kepauka matɨari paa peme'imanitsie, mɨtiyetuiwatsie timieme pekaniyetuamɨkɨ, harina 'aixɨa mɨ'ane papayari.
Yunaitɨ 'anuiwarima mekateniyetuayakuni yemekɨ Yawé hetsiemieme matɨari memɨte'imanitsie timieme.
Mawarika 'axamɨtiuyuri hetsiemieme kepauka mɨka'imani
»Mɨpaɨta pɨtiɨyɨwe mɨpaɨ xekateha'eriwatɨ 'axaxepɨte'uyuriwawe, 'inɨari niukiyaritsie Yawé miyetua Muitsexi hetsɨa,
naime 'inɨari Yawé mɨxeyetuirie Muitsexi hetsɨa, kepauka mɨpaɨ mutayɨ kename xenuiwari wahetsiemiemetɨni.

Xɨka 'axamete'uyurieni yunaitɨ kiekatari mɨpaɨ mekateha'eriwatɨ, hikɨ mɨkɨ xeime tsikeru xeiwiyari hɨkame mekanitataiyakuni witsi'u'ɨakame Yawé minake, kaxie winuyari mɨtayeuriwa heutinɨkame, hatsite mawariyari, xeime tsipu 'uki 'itiya mawariyari mayanikɨ, kemɨre'uxa.

Hikɨ mawari wewiwame yunaime 'ixaheritsixi kaniwaxɨnamɨkɨ, mekateneuyehɨwiyariekuni memɨka'imakɨ, meta Yawé hetsiemieme mawarika taiyariyari memuwewikɨ meta 'itiya mawariyari memuwewikɨ meta 'axamemɨte'uyuri meka'imaitɨwetɨ.
Yunaitɨ teɨteri 'ixaheritsixi mekateneuyehɨwiyariekuni, meta 'ateewa kiekatari, yunaitɨ 'axamemɨte'uyurikɨ meka'imaitɨwetɨ yuhetsie.
»Xɨka yuxaɨta 'axatiuyurieni ka'imainetɨ, xeime tsipu 'ukaratsi kaniyetuamɨkɨ xeiwiyari hɨkame 'itiya mawariyari mayanikɨ.
Mawari wewiwame kanixɨnamɨkɨ Yawé hɨxie 'axamɨtiuyuri ka'imainetɨ. Mawari wewiwame yakatiniyurimɨkɨ, hikɨ tewi 'axamɨtiuyuri katineuyehɨwiyariemɨkɨ.
'Ikɨ yuxewitɨ xeikɨa 'inɨari yunaitɨ wahetsie kanimiemetɨni kemɨ'ane 'axamɨtiuyuri ka'imainetɨ, 'ixaheri tewiyari hetsiemieme meta 'ateewa kiekame wahamatɨa muka hetsiemieme.
»Peru kemɨ'ane 'axamɨtiuyuri mima, tsepa mana munuiwakame yatɨni 'ateewa mɨkiekame, Yawé hɨxie 'axakatiniuyurieni. Mɨkɨ yuteɨterima watsata payeweiyarieni.
Yuhetsie kanihɨimɨkɨ Yawé niukieya mutananaimakɨ, 'inɨari niukiyaritsie yamɨkatikatɨakɨ».
'Uxipiya tukari mɨnanaima
Heiwamieme 'uxipiya tukaritsie, 'ixaheritsixi me'uxipiekaku makumawetsie, xewitɨ 'ixaheri kaniuxeiyarieni kɨyexi naiwame 'ɨnetɨ.
Hikɨ kemɨ'ane memixei meneiwitɨni Muitsexi meta 'Aruni wahetsɨa yunaime 'ixaheritsixi wahɨxie.
Matɨari kananutahɨiyakatɨni xeikɨa, mɨkahahekɨakaikɨ kememiyurienikekai.
Hikɨ Yawé Muitsexi mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: «Mɨkɨ tewi ke'umierieni. Yunaitɨ 'ixaheritsixi mekeheitituaxixɨani 'ateewa paitɨ».
Hikɨ 'ixaheritsixi mematiteitsie 'aheteewakaku mekaneihana, mekaneitituaxixɨani mekanimieni, Yawé Muitsexi kemɨrahɨawekai.
Matawɨ memaye'eriwanikɨ
Yawé Muitsexi mɨpaɨ katiniuta'aitɨani
'ixaheritsixi mɨpaɨ mɨtiwatahɨawekɨ: «Xeme xeyunaitɨ xenuiwarima yukamixa 'amɨtɨtɨtsie matawɨre xekanawipaxɨakuni hiru mɨyɨtsikimaɨyekɨ.
Mɨkɨ matawɨ xekamixatetsie kanixeparewiemɨkɨ xemaye'eriwanikɨ, naime 'inɨari niukiyari Yawé hetsiemieme xemɨkayuwaɨriyanikɨ xe'iyari kemɨtixekuyuitɨwa meta xehɨxite ketita mɨreuhiwe'erie.
Naime ne'aitsika xekanexeiyakakuni, xekaneye'atɨakakuni. Mɨpaɨ xe'anetɨ neteɨterima memɨpatsie xekanihɨkɨtɨkakuni
Ne Yawé xekakaɨyari nekanihɨkɨtɨni, nemɨxe'ayewitɨ 'Ekipitu xekakaɨyari nemayanikɨ. Ne Yawé nepɨhɨkɨ».
